chapter: Armstrong, Parker and life inside the Basie band
title: Why he is called Buddy: George Holmes Tate
summary: He was named George after Washington; his sister who died of typhoid called him Buddy.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: You were born George Holmes Tate.
George? Yeah, I got the George from George Washington. My birthday is February 22nd.
And my daddy was -- his name was Marshall Holmes Tate.
Holmes, that was his middle name. So they gave me his middle name.
And where did you get the Buddy?

My sister named me Buddy that I never knew. She died when she was 16 with scarlet fever. And -- typhoid fever, rather. They had a typhoid fever epidemic throughout there and it just killed so many people. But I was -- I imagine I was -- she and my father died around the same time. And another brother that I didn't know. He was 14, she was 16. They died a month apart, I think, maybe six months after my father or before. I can't remember who died first. But she was the one that named me Buddy.
So you always grew up as Buddy.
As Buddy. And of course, people that I was going to school, they knew me as George, you know, George
as my real name. But Buddy -- George really sounds funny to me, you know.
But my son-in-laws, my two son-in-laws call me George and my daughters, they call me George. "Hey, George," you know.
